recipes.title: Classic Margherita Pizza
recipes.description: Authentic Neapolitan pizza with fresh basil, mozzarella, and rich tomato sauce.
recipes.instructions:
1. Dissolve yeast in warm water and combine with flour and salt to form dough.
2. Let dough rise for 1 hour.
3. Roll out dough, spread tomato sauce, and layer fresh mozzarella slices.
4. Bake at 240°C (460°F) for 12-15 minutes until crust is golden.
5. Top with fresh basil and drizzle olive oil before serving.

recipes.title: Creamy Butter Chicken
recipes.description: Rich and velvety North Indian curry made with tender chicken pieces in a spiced tomato-butter sauce.
recipes.instructions:
1. Marinate chicken with yogurt and spices for at least 30 mins.
2. Sear chicken pieces in a hot skillet until charred.
3. Prepare gravy by cooking butter, garlic, tomato puree, and spices.
4. Stir in cream and cooked chicken. Simmer for 10 mins.
5. Garnish with fresh coriander and serve hot with naan.

recipes.title: Avocado & Quinoa Power Bowl
recipes.description: Nutritious and vibrant vegan bowl packed with superfoods, roasted chickpeas, and tahini dressing.
recipes.instructions:
1. Arrange cooked quinoa and fresh spinach in a bowl.
2. Top with sliced avocado, roasted chickpeas, and halved cherry tomatoes.
3. Whisk tahini, lemon juice, and 1 tbsp water to make dressing.
4. Drizzle dressing over the bowl and serve chilled.
